_note: Grace eval set. Run: npm run eval  (needs Ollama up). Each item scores latency plus a light correctness signal. Checks: expectContainsAny (reply includes one of), expectToolAny (one of these tools ran), expectNotTool (none of these ran), maxLatencyMs. Keep this set small and stable so model/harness changes are comparable over time.
